name: svelte
description: web development for the rest of us
one_liner: A popular, free framework developers use to build fast, lightweight websites and web apps.
buyer: No direct buyer — it's a free open-source framework. The business opportunity is in the products built with it, not the framework itself.
business_use_cases: A freelance web developer builds fast client websites with it and charges for the build, not the tool.
A startup ships a snappy web app with less code and a smaller bundle size than competitors using heavier frameworks.
An agency specializes in Svelte development and sells it as a premium, performance-focused offering to clients who've had slow sites built elsewhere.

money_ideas.idea: Build an agency or freelance practice specializing in fast Svelte builds and sell that expertise, not the framework

steal_this: This is a dev tool, not a product — the real weekend project is a client website or app built with it, not anything shipped around the framework itself.
